commit.message:
fix(devcontainer-setup): pin fnm instead of installing its latest release (#346)

* fix(devcontainer-setup): pin fnm instead of installing its latest release

Fixes one half of #330.

The generated Dockerfile pins and version-checks most of what it fetches
(GIT_DELTA_VERSION, FZF_VERSION, ZSH_IN_DOCKER_VERSION), but fnm's installer
defaults to RELEASE="latest", so every devcontainer built from the template
took whatever the newest release was at build time.

The installer accepts --release, so this pins it the same way as the rest of
the file, via an FNM_VERSION arg.

The other unpinned install, claude.ai/install.sh, is left alone deliberately:
I could not retrieve that script to establish whether it supports a version
pin, and I am not going to guess at a flag. Recording that in the PR instead
of changing it.

Verified by building the image: the run downloads
github.com/Schniz/fnm/releases/download/v1.39.0/fnm-linux.zip, so the pin takes
effect, and the build completes.

* chore(devcontainer-setup): bump plugin version to 0.2.5

The validate job requires the plugin version to increase whenever a plugin file
changes, so clients pull the update. Version was 0.2.4 at the merge base.

* chore(devcontainer-setup): sync the marketplace version with plugin.json

52eff21 bumped plugin.json to 0.2.5 but left the marketplace entry at 0.2.4, so
the two manifests disagreed. The validator requires them to match and the
client resolves the plugin through the marketplace entry.

---------

Co-authored-by: kz-tob <kara.zaffarano@trailofbits.com>

files.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 {
   "name": "devcontainer-setup",
-  "version": "0.2.4",
+  "version": "0.2.5",
   "description": "Create pre-configured devcontainers with Claude Code and language-specific tooling",
   "author": {
     "name": "Alexis Challande",

@@ -86,8 +86,11 @@ RUN uv tool install ast-grep-cli
 
 # Install fnm (Fast Node Manager) and Node 22
 ARG NODE_VERSION=22
+# Pin fnm rather than taking its installer's default of "latest", matching the
+# versioned installs above. The installer's --release flag selects the tag.
+ARG FNM_VERSION=1.39.0
 ENV FNM_DIR="/home/vscode/.fnm"
-RUN curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash -s -- --install-dir "$FNM_DIR" --skip-shell && \
+RUN curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash -s -- --install-dir "$FNM_DIR" --skip-shell --release "v${FNM_VERSION}" && \
   export PATH="$FNM_DIR:$PATH" && \
   eval "$(fnm env)" && \
   fnm install ${NODE_VERSION} && \
